text_block_list.text:
During her first three years in the 
Twinkle Series, Wonder Acute achieved 
quite a commendable record.

And so the seasons turn. Just as there are 
new encounters, there are unexpected 
partings as well...

The two of us came to the airport to see 
Wonder Acute off.

text_block_list.name: Acute's Father
text_block_list.text: Well then, Acute, Trainer. Take care!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Yeah... But Dad, I was really surprised...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Who would've thought I'd get another shot 
at boxing in America?

text_block_list.name: Acute's Father
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Well, calling it a 'retry' might 
be a stretch since I'm no pro. But still――

text_block_list.name: Acute's Father
text_block_list.text:
I can't quit while things are left 
unfinished! I don't want to lose to my 
daughter, after all.

text_block_list.name: Acute's Father
text_block_list.text:
"So with that said, you two! I'm leaving 
the gym in your hands!"
(Screeech!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I don't think my hearing's gone 
bad, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Didn't Pops say, 'Take care of the gym'?

Managing a boxing gym... I was entrusted 
with quite an outrageous job. And then...

text_block_list.name: Running Trainees
text_block_list.text: (Heave-ho! Heave-ho!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone, sto~p! That's it for the 
roadwork. Next up..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Shadowboxing, start~!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Whoosh, whoosh! Whoosh, whoosh!

text_block_list.name: Boxing Trainees
text_block_list.text: Yes, President!

While continuing her racing career, Wonder 
Acute was appointed president of the 
boxing gym.

Naturally, not being a professional boxer, 
I couldn't provide proper instruction. 
However—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"The most important thing of all is 
'charisma.' As long as you've got that, 
you can lead everyone, you see."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, more than his track record, Dad was 
beloved by many trainees for his 
character, you know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I can't teach you technique, but I can 
get you motivated."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Don't you agree, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, there's no doubt about that.
Yeah, there's no doubt about that.

text_block_list.text:
The tenacity shown in the Twinkle Series, 
and the charisma inherited from her 
father...

Wonder Acute was an absolutely perfect 
presence to serve as the symbol of the 
gym.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Even so~ There are quite a lot of people 
at the gym, so going around encouraging 
everyone and kicking their butts is, 
well...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If only there was at least one more 
Umamusume to help out...

Umâif it's just pacing along on your 
roadwork, shall I help you out?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ooooh... You're... Grass-chan!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You were so good to me over Christmas. So 
if there's any small way I can help out~♪
An unexpected supporter appeared.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Thank you so much, Grass-chan. 
Well then, let's see...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
First, could you change clothes, and hold 
'this'?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Is this... a bamboo sword? Am I supposed 
to hold it and do something?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Nah~, you just have to hold it, so could 
you give the trainees some tough~ love 
cheers?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
“Holding a shinai, giving harsh~ 
cheers...”

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Understood. Well then~♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Listen closely, everyone. A race is a 
matter of "win or fall." Exposing oneself 
to disgrace is the height of folly.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Face this with unyielding resolve. Know 
that effort without results is nothing."

text_block_list.name: Boxing Trainee 1
text_block_list.text: Oooooooh... somehow...

text_block_list.name: Boxing Trainee 2
text_block_list.text:
"It really tightens your focus to an 
insane degree. Feels like I'd get cut in 
two if I lost..."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? I would never try to slash at 
anyone. However~...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If it serves as fuel to spur you toward 
victory, nothing would make me happier♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, would it be permissible for me to 
join this gym's setup as well?

With this, our new structure is set. With 
Wonder Acute leading the way, the three of 
us will support the gym.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, Grass-chan and I will run in 
the Twinkle Series~. And everyone else in 
the ring~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Guess I'll go for a run and aim to become 
the champion, huh?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: And a-one, two♪ One, two♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: One, two♪ One, two♪

text_block_list.name: Running Trainees
text_block_list.text: One, two! One, two!

—All as one. Cheerful voices from their 
running session echo across the river's 
surface.

Supporting others and being supported in 
turn, let us continue to aim for glory 
together.
